h: Wike makes fresh claim about Peter Obi, saying he gave him his political start
p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly made a new claim about Peter Obi, saying he helped him in the past. Obi's camp has not yet responded to the remarks. The comments are drawing wide reaction as 2027 campaigning heats up.
more: Wike has previously said he gave Obi logistics support in 2023.
Supporters of Obi have disputed Wike's accounts before.
